title: The Lord Comforts Zion

questions.question: Listen to me, you who pursue righteousness, you who seek the LORD: look to the what from which you were hewn?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 51:1 (ESV): "look to the rock from which you were hewn,"

questions.question: Look to Abraham your father and to whom who bore you?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 51:2 (ESV): "and to Sarah who bore you;"

questions.question: For the LORD comforts Zion; he comforts all her waste places and makes her wilderness like what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 51:3 (ESV): "and makes her wilderness like Eden,"

questions.question: Lift up your eyes to the heavens, and look at the earth beneath; for the heavens vanish like smoke, the earth will wear out like a what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 51:6 (ESV): "the earth will wear out like a garment,"

questions.question: But my salvation will be forever, and my righteousness will never be what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 51:6 (ESV): "and my righteousness will never be dismayed."

questions.question: Listen to me, you who know righteousness, the people in whose heart is my what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 51:7 (ESV): "the people in whose heart is my law;"

questions.question: Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of the LORD; awake, as in days of old, the generations of long ago. Was it not you who cut whom in pieces?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 51:9 (ESV): "Was it not you who cut Rahab in pieces,"

questions.question: And the ransomed of the LORD shall return and come to Zion with singing; everlasting joy shall be upon their what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 51:11 (ESV): "everlasting joy shall be upon their heads;"

questions.question: I, I am he who comforts you; who are you that you are afraid of man who dies, of the son of man who is made like what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 51:12 (ESV): "of the son of man who is made like grass,"

questions.question: And has forgotten the LORD your Maker, who stretched out the heavens and laid the foundations of the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 51:13 (ESV): "and laid the foundations of the earth,"

questions.question: Wake yourself, wake yourself, stand up, O Jerusalem, you who have drunk from the hand of the LORD the cup of his what?
Who have drunk to the dregs the bowl, the cup of what?

These two things have happened to you—who will console you?—devastation and destruction, famine and sword; who will comfort you? Your sons have fainted; they lie at the head of every street like an antelope in a what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 51:20 (ESV): "like an antelope in a net." (ESV text: "like an antelope in a net.")

questions.question: Thus says your Lord, the LORD, your God who pleads the cause of his people: "Behold, I have taken from your hand the cup of staggering; the bowl of my what you shall drink no more?"
questions.explanation: Isaiah 51:22 (ESV): "the bowl of my wrath you shall drink no more;"

questions.question: And I will put it into the hand of your tormentors, who have said to you, "Bow down, that we may pass over"; and you have made your back like the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 51:23 (ESV): "and you have made your back like the ground"

key_verse_text: And the ransomed of the LORD shall return and come to Zion with singing; everlasting joy shall be upon their heads; they shall obtain gladness and joy, and sorrow and sighing shall flee away.
